data.gender_notes: Azin is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'azana', which means 'to protect'. In Islamic tradition, Azin is a name given to a girl believed to be a protector and guardian, often used for daughters born to families with many sons. The name Azin carries the meaning “Protector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azin usually hope their child will grow to embody protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with spiritual significance in Islam, representing the protective role of Allah in one's life.
data.etymology: Azin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azin total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
